processNotes: The historical work order records Subassembly at location 50; using it for the complete demonstration is an inferred routing, not an engineering specification.

The BOM does not establish mounting geometry, fastener placement or the freewheel's relationship to the other components. Confirm compatibility and the applicable manufacturer instructions before fitting; otherwise retain the components as a kit.
